outputs.explanation: Panel A is a spatial cluster map (micrograph-type image), not a plot showing averaged data; the check does not apply.
Panel B shows H&E histology images with manual annotations, not a quantitative plot; the check does not apply.
Panel C shows an H&E image and spatial expression heatmap overlays on tissue sections; these are spatial visualizations, not bar/scatter plots of averaged data, so the check does not apply.
Panel D consists of GSEA enrichment line plots. Line plots are exempt from the individual-data-points requirement as overlaying points would make them unreadable.

Panel E is a bar chart showing log2 fold-change values (derived from group-level differential expression comparisons) for several genes, but no individual data points (e.g., per-spot expression values) are overlaid on the bars, so the underlying variability cannot be assessed.
